create_big_query_service: create a BigQuery service object by authenticating with Google Cloud Platform application default credentials
create_dataset: create a new BigQuery dataset in a specified project with the given dataset ID
create_partitioned_table: create a partitioned BigQuery table with day-level time partitioning and a 30 day expiration policy
insert_rows: insert multiple rows into a BigQuery table using the insertAll API with retry logic
sync_query_job: execute a synchronous SQL query against BigQuery and return the query job result
